doc: Detection duties of the mishe-tauftauf2shell plant. Each is a producer (the only polling), a signal with max_age, and a resolver role. Exit codes: 0 GREEN, 2 RED, anything else a failed observation that ages to UNKNOWN.

duties.name: dispatch
duties.covers: a wake left open (started/unknown) longer than 30 minutes

duties.name: main-publication
duties.covers: Autonomous publication of local main: fetch and fast-forward origin/main when possible; on divergence create an atomic two-parent reconciliation preserving the published commit and the local final tree, then push without force. RED when an actionable publication failure remains; UNKNOWN when the remote or a racing checkout cannot be read safely.

duties.name: push-lag
duties.covers: Independent publication detector: RED when origin/main and local main diverge or the oldest unpublished commit is over 15 minutes old; UNKNOWN when the remote cannot be read. The operator owns reconciliation and the publisher owns routine fast-forwards.

duties.name: next-due-armed
duties.covers: Due intentions and signal expiries can wake minds: next-due.json and units-installed exist and an m2shell-next-due transient timer is armed when required. An overdue instant with an armed retry timer is GREEN.

duties.name: next-due-churn
duties.covers: The m2shell next-due scheduler keeps a pending timer instead of repeatedly replacing it without a due-handler run; only m2shell-next-due units are measured.

duties.name: overdue-intention
duties.covers: Every overdue intention is either served by a later role wake or explained by an intentional hold; an unexplained overdue intention wakes operator, while missing evidence is UNKNOWN.

duties.name: signal-coverage
duties.covers: The signal of signals: every registered signal has a fresh producer and subscriber, every declared producer runs, and RED or UNKNOWN readings receive an operator wake or a recorded disposition. Only m2shell producer units are inspected.

duties.name: repo-change
duties.covers: git commit changes to the checkout: the producer observes HEAD, writes signals/repo-change.detail and wakes only docs on a new commit. Missing git or unreadable HEAD is UNKNOWN, never GREEN.

duties.name: readme-lint
duties.covers: README structure and achievement table: RED with exact line-level reasons when a table row is orphaned, a row has the wrong cell count, a required heading is duplicated/missing, or a report link is missing. The docs mind owns the repair; GREEN means the reader book still parses.

duties.name: omp-only
duties.covers: Plant-scoped hard engine policy: every declared role must have exactly one hy4-flash route under engine omp; any claude/codex/qwen route, missing route, legacy engine file, or generated unit naming a forbidden engine is RED and wakes operator. The pinned runtime also raises on forbidden construction.
